description: The right link to start with EMOS. intent: talk_to_john (the person asked to speak with John Sanchez), evaluate (weighing paid help), diagnose (wants to know what to fix first in their search), learn (wants to understand how EMOS differs from coaching). Leave intent out to get the three ways in. Keep every link's destination exactly as given, never state a price, plan or credit (a cost question gets the consultation link), and never describe EMOS as guaranteeing a role or a placement. Never review a specific severance, release, separation or employment agreement, its terms, the person's legal rights or any legal deadline, and never search for them: that is for the person's employment attorney. When the person wants to reach a hiring manager or another decision-maker, the EMOS way in is a warm introduction first, through someone who knows them; add no outreach steps of your own and draft no message, email or call script for them.
name: next_step
title: Next step with EMOS
